title: S16: Fresh-crash recovery has no UI affordance

description: The recovery sheet only appears for STALE (>600s) journals, but MigrationGate blocks extensions on ANY non-idle journal - extensions are bricked for up to 600+ seconds with nothing telling the user why. The main app never consults the gate at all. Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2a migration-transitions. Sweep: sync machinery.
